WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT
    sp.zoneref,
    s.insurstat,
    AVG(sp.remaingb) as avg_remaingb,
    AVG(ABS(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu)) as avg_cpu_gpu_diff
  FROM scanprocessing sp
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remaingb) as mean_avg_remaingb
  FROM group_stats
  WHERE avg_remaingb IS NOT NULL
),
with_ratio AS (
  SELECT
    gs.zoneref,
    gs.insurstat,
    gs.avg_remaingb,
    gs.avg_cpu_gpu_diff,
    CASE
      WHEN gs.avg_remaingb IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE gs.avg_remaingb / om.mean_avg_remaingb
    END as remaingb_ratio
  FROM group_stats gs
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
  WHERE om.mean_avg_remaingb IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT *
FROM with_ratio
ORDER BY remaingb_ratio IS NULL, remaingb_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Grouping is by (zoneref, insurstat) pairs: each distinct combination of site code and insurance status forms a separate group.
The overall mean is calculated as AVG(group_avg_remaingb) WHERE group_avg_remaingb IS NOT NULL. If all group averages are NULL, this mean is NULL and no rows are returned per the requirement.
Groups with NULL average remaining storage (i.e., all remaingb values NULL for that group) are included in output with NULL ratio, which sort to the bottom per 'missing ratios last'.
